verdict.rationale: Retell's AI QA automatically evaluates calls against configured rules and metrics. It scores hallucination, knowledge base accuracy, latency, sentiment and tool usage, and built-in call success scoring covers resolution outcomes. Conductor can then examine low-scoring calls and compare failures. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, evaluation of all calls rather than a sampled set, and explicit documentation of resolution analysis beyond call-success scoring.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform's AI reviews my calls for me — scoring quality, flagging failures, and analyzing resolution automatically

citations.quote: AI QA scores Retell calls on hallucination, knowledge base accuracy, latency, sentiment, and tool usage to surface quality trends and issues.
